description: Instant Melee on i76_pristine_fix.exe (run_scenario --nomission --exe i76_pristine_fix.exe --ai 1): no scripted end, one AI opponent so the AI loop, its fire decisions and the damage chain run. Engine started if off, then throttle (W), circles (W+A, W+D) with a weapon_fire burst (Enter) between legs, a stop, and throttle to the end. Keys per the sandbox input.map.
